name: codex-trace
description: Local, read-only Codex execution trajectory viewer with verified local ZIP export.

interface.longDescription: View saved task execution traces in the local Codex desktop app. Browse messages and model/tool inputs and outputs by turn, search loaded records, follow confirmed child-agent links, and export raw records as local ZIP files with source manifests and SHA-256 checksums. Codex Trace reads source records without modifying them. Derived indexes, reading preferences, export receipts, and temporary snapshots are stored locally. A compatible local Codex CLI is required. The community GitHub marketplace package requires Git and uv; uv prepares Python 3.14.2 and locked dependencies, with network access when they are not cached. The optional ZIP installer requires Python 3.14+; optional offline platform packages bundle a runtime. This community project has not been reviewed or endorsed by the OpenAI public plugin directory. Cloud tasks and browser execution are unsupported. Missing records and unknown states are shown explicitly; verified exports do not establish source completeness.
capabilities: Browse saved local Codex messages and model/tool inputs and outputs
Search, filter, and locate loaded execution records
Follow confirmed links to child-agent execution traces
Export raw records as local ZIP files with source manifests and SHA-256 checksums
